item.title: Version 1.50.6 (138)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.50.6

Build 138

  • Shows file count, transferred size, and current filename while pasting folders
  • Shows live copy progress on the destination folder in the tree
  • Refreshes copied folders in loaded tree branches
  • Removes the ambiguous culling hourglass icon
